item.title: [+1] India's GDP to grow 7.1-7.3% in FY27, pvt investment to revive: Deloitte
item.description:
Signal: stronger Indian growth data (India). 16 reports from Business Standard, Animation Xpress, tennews.in and 11 more. Related: “Deloitte projects India's GDP to grow 7.1-7.3% in FY27”. New in the last 24 hours.

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Orders and capex firm

Why it matters: Better activity data points to firmer demand, orders and credit growth, supporting earnings across cyclical sectors.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +3, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] India-US trade pact would be concluded at earliest, in interest of global trade: FM Sitharaman
item.description:
Signal: trade deal or tariff relief for India (India). 29 reports from Telangana Today, The Economic Times, indica News and 20 more. Related: “India notifies first New Zealand FTA duty cuts; sheep meat gets zero duty, kiwi fruit at 15%”. Turn: earlier readings (11 Oct) pointed the other way.

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Engineering exports gain access

Why it matters: Lower tariffs or a trade deal open markets for Indian exporters and attract investment into export manufacturing.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months
